segments.text: Kung sakasakali po, pagdating po ng 2028, meron po tayong 74 million.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Pagdating po ng Barangay NSK election na second week of November of 2028,

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: sabihin na po natin may dagdag na 1 million kasi meron po magkikinsi-anyos na mga votante, na mga SK.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: So, magkikinsi-anyos po sila, dagdag po sila doon.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: At yung mga nagkikinsi naman ngayon, pwede po maging 18 later.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: So, madadagdag po sa atin.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Pag po nag-reset tayo ng Barangay NSK, lagi pong hihingi kami ng dagdag na budget.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Kasi po, dagdag na votante, dagdag na president.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Dagdag na electoral board members, dagdag na election para Pernalia.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Maraming salamat po.

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: Ang masasayang lang, yung talagang tapon, ito yung manpower utilization, di ba?

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: In terms of, for the preparation.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Yes po, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: Like overtime pay, etc.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Yes po, pero yun po naman, yun naman po, Mr. Chair, ay nagamit namin yung mga overtime

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: para lang po masigurado namin na piprint namin na maayos yung mga balot.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Masisigurado pong nakahanda lahat yung mga presinto natin, yung mga polling place natin.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: So, technically, hindi naman po, wala po, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: Thank you. So, let's listen to your presentation.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Maraming salamat po, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: Yun na yung question and answer. Pagkatapos ng presentation, submitted na.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Maraming salamat po, Mr. Chair, your honors.

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: Go ahead, please.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Kung inyo pong mamarapatin.

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: Yes.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Maraming salamat po, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: With your kind permission, nabigyan lang po ako ng konting maiksing-maiksing,

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: munting accomplishment po ng inyong commission election nitong nakaraang 2025.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Ang aming pong budget utilization for 2025 ay 97%.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Sapagkat ang 2025 po ay national and local election, midterm elections po yan.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: So, halos talaga pong nagamit namin ang lahat ng ating pong budget.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: At dito po inalaan talaga, hindi lamang sa commission, kung hindi po yung pagkukondak natin,

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: ng halala.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Ang 2025 po ay napakataas.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Ang voters turn out, 82.2%.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Pinakamataas po yan sa kasaysayan ng midterm election sa ating midterm election.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: At dito pong 2025 din, ang inyong Comelec ay nahalal bilang chairperson ng Association of World Electoral Bodies.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: At the same time, Association of Asian Electoral Authorities.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Both at the same time, first time po na nangyari yan sa kasaysayan ng inyong dalawang electoral bodies.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Of course, madami po kami naisagawa.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Maliban sa national and local elections, na pinakamabilis po noong 2025 sapagkat nakapagproklamo po kami ng mayor sa gabi ng araw na eleksyon noong May 14.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Kinabukasan, nakapagproklamo po kami ng mga congressmen at gobernador.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Yung pong mga senador na proklamo namin in five days.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: At yung party list na proklamo po namin in seven days.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: The fastest in the history of Philippine election.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Ngayon po, recently po, ang aming kahit paanong munting accomplishment, ay yung pong Bangsamoro parliamentary election.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Kauna-una.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Sa ating kasaysayan.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Magbaga mat hindi po perfecto, ito po yung nagkaroon ng 84.34% voters turnout.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Highest.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: 84.34% po highest in the history of our country's election.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Madami pong talagang bumoto ng mga kababayan natin.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: At mukha naman po accepted, acceptable sa lahat ng mga majority party, minority party at iba pang mga partido politikal.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Sa pagkat highly contested, napakaliit lang po ng lamangan.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Yung isa nakakuha ng 16 seats, yung isa nakakuha ng 15 seats, yung isa nakakuha ng 8 seats, at yung isa nakakuha ng 1 seat.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Subalit yung pong mga sectoral organizations, kahit po yung mga parliamentary districts, ay wala naman po mga narinig kami mga conference din.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: We were able to proclaim the 80 seats all in all.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: The next day lang po.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Bago po inabot ng gabi, na proklamo na po kaagad namin yung ating mga nanalo na mga parliamentary districts.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Members ng Bangsamoro.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: So, yan po at the same time ang Inyapong Commission on Election was awarded the Commission of the Year.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: International award po yung aming tinanggap na yun.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Plus all four other awards given by the international body, ICPS, to the Commission on Election.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: So kahit paano po, ay malaking accomplishments sa amin.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Including the three consecutive for the first time in the 85-year history of the Comelec.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Kami po yung nakakuha ng tatlong magkakasunod na unqualified opinion from the Commission on Audit.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: So, yun naman po ay kahit paano, yung pananalapi, mapagmamalaki namin na inaayos po namin upang kahit paano,

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: may pagtitiwala ang tao at masigurado ang proper accountability and transparency.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Kaya lang po, Mr. Chair, kami po yung nag-propose dahil naghahanda po kami ng halalang para sa 2028.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Nag-propose po kami.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Na sana makakapag-print na kami ng balota next year.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Sana makapag-procure na kami ng machine by next year.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Hindi po po pwedeng 2028 ang pag-print ng balota, pag-procure ng machines, at lahat po ng mga gagawin ay hindi pwedeng 2028.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Dapat po lahat siyan, sa karanasan natin, ay a year before the election.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Ang problem po ay nabawasan po kami, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Mr. Chair, if I may lang po. May tanong lang ako, isang question lang.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Napapansin ko, tumataas na yung trajectory ng mga voters' turnout.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: From 2016, am I correct? 2019, 2022, 2025, until sa BARM election, yung pataas siya, no?

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Yes po.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Ibig sabihin, nagpa-participate na po ang mga kababayan natin, mga voters, tumataas na.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Tama po kayo, Mr. Chair. In fact, ang kabataan ng 2025, 45% ng mga kabataan ang bumoto po ng 2025 National and Local Elections.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: At kita niyo po, kahit po barangay ng SK Elections, mataas din po ang voters' turnout.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Sa dito pong Bangsamoro, after more or less three postponements, nakapagtataka at nakakatuwa po, 84.34%.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Maalala ko before, about 70% up lang po. Ngayon, umabot na ng 82%, umabot na ng 84% nung BARM elections.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Ibig sabihin, nagpa-participate na po ang mga ating mga kababayan. Sana, tumaas pa lalo ito to 90%.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Sana po. Ang isa pong dahilan talaga din po dyan is automation of the election.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: And at the same time, siguro po yung malawakang voters'

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: education campaign. At tulong na rin po ng iba't ibang civil society organizations.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Meron lang akong gustong i-suggest rin po sa inyo. Pakicheck nyo lang po.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Napansin ko, kahit na 82% yung voters' turnout sa national natin,

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: but sa mga overseas Filipino na voters natin, less than 50% po yung turnout.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: So, maaaring tingnan nyo na hindi na sila mahirapan or na bumoto or mainganyo silang,

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: bumoto, maaaring malayo o nahirapan sila, baka maka ano kayo, makagawa kayo ng bagong sistema

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: na mas maging convenient para sa mga overseas Filipino.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Maraming salamat po, Mr. Chair. Kami po ay nagsagawa na sa kauna-unang pagkakataon in our history

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: ng ating tinatawag na internet voting nito pong 2025.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Maaaring po kasing bago at syempre po medyo sinasalat pa ng mga kababayan natin kung paano talaga ito tinitingnan.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Hindi po ganun kataas. Sa isang midterm elections po, Mr. Chair, lagi po siyang mababa.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Hindi pa po siya tumaas ng 20%. Noong nakaraang 2020, kahit po noong 2022, inabot lang po ng 18.3%.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Ito pong 2025, 18.2%. Pero po pagka presidential election, tumataas po siya, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Noong 2022 po, presidential election, inabot po siya ng 40.59%.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: So, less than 50% pa rin po.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Yes po, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Para naman mabigyan sila ng pagkakataon.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Yung mga OFWs natin, gustong-gustong bumoto noon.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Kaya lang siguro, maaaring yung oras nila o yung saan sila pupunta o hindi nila alam na meron na tayong online voting.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Baka yung formation campaign nyo po, mas mapaigting pa po.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Salamat po.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Maraming salamat po, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: So, kami po, Mr. Chair, ay nabawasan ng 7 billion yung una.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Tinanggal po namin, zero po kami sa budget para sa aming pinapagawang building.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Zero po kami sa budget para sa mga local.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Zero po kami sa mga field-integrated offices po namin.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Originally po, 7 billion ang tinanggal sa amin.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Pero pagdating po ng NEP, nadagdagan po ito ng 15 point something billion.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: So, more or less po, 22, 23 billion ang nawala po sa amin.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Ang problema po namin, doon po sa 15 billion na nawala sa amin,

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: okay na po yung tinanggal lang kami sa regular agency budget.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Pwede po kami magtipid ng lahat.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Pero we cannot compromise, Mr. Chair, yung automated election natin ng 2028.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Tinanggal po sa amin, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: For example, tayo po ay magkakailanganin po natin more or less 24,000 machines.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: 124,000 machines para sa 2028 elections.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Kung kaya lang po, natanggalan po kami more or less ng 1.6 billion.

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: Question, if you know, how much has the House restored?

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: Kasi we have not received the GAB, the General [unclear] Bill, yung house version.

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: And if you know, nag-restore ba sila sa...

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Wala po, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: During the budget deliberation po, nakiusap na lang ako sa, kami po sa committee on appropriation, subcommittee on appropriation,

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: na kung pe pwede.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Kung yung pong, kasi alam po namin, Mr. Chair, yung 16% na napakaliit na space, budget space po natin,

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: mukhang wala naman po kami pagkukuhanan kung saan pa natin kukuhanan yung departamento.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Ang sabi na lang po namin, kung sakali pong hindi matutuloy ang barangay ng SK elections,

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: baka pa pwede pong yung 10.9 billion na unexpended balance, gamitin na lang po namin, ilagay na lang po,

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: at kaya po nakakatuwa doon sa BSKE po na ilagay.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Pero ang Congress din po, sa kanila pong special provision, ilalagay din daw po yung provision na yan

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: para daw po makasigurado na may magagamit si Comelec.

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: Understood. So you're hoping na ma-postpone?

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Yes po, kaya po, Mr. Chair. Kami naman po, naandito kami, hindi po para pabigatin ang problema pa ng committee

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: kung saan po kukuhanin pa yung sa amin. Yung sa amin lang po is, sana po mailagay na lang din as a special provision

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: yung pong nailagay sa barangay ng SK. Malaking tulong na po yun,

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: because maibabalik po namin, Mr. Chair, yung 9 billion, 9.2 billion na nawala kay Comelec

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: na pang national and local election.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Yung natitira pong kulang-kulang na 2 billion, yun na lang po yung gagamitin namin pang-hire ng casual employees,

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: yung pong sa registration of voters namin, and such other activities na natanggal po sa regular agency budget.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Ang importante po, okay na po yung 11 billion kesa po, kahit po nawala yung buong 15, at least po mayroon kami yung 11 billion.

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: Kindly update, kasi yung binigay sa aking briefer, yung sa utilization rate,

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: well, it is true na 99.9 yung, as of December 31, yung aming data.

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: Kung meron kayong as of June 30, 2026, kindly update us.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Yes, po, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: Kasi yung sa, yung na-release talagang nasa 99.9%, no?

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: 47.334 billion ang na-release, na iwan lang 32 million eh.

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: But of the release amount, 26.4 billion or 55.9%

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: lang yung obligated.

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: Okay, so yung 20.861 billion, corresponding to 44.1%, yun ang remain unobligated.

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: Pero yung disbursement rate, again, mataas.

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: So,

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: So, Mr. Chair, sa kasalukuyan po, as of September 15, ang aming pong budget utilization ay 38.68%,

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: sapagkat ito nga po yung sa barangay ng SK, yung part ng period po,

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: Yeah, I know. Pero yung obligation, yung unobligated, nabawasan na?

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Yes.

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: Naka-factorin yung BSKE?

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Yes, po, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: Ah, okay. Thank you. Understood.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: So, dito po ako para sumuporta sa inyo.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Anyway, I would like to congratulate the Comelec, led by Chairperson George Garcia,

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: sa lahat po na empleyado, sa lahat ng commissioners, ng directors ng Comelec,

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: for the successful conduct of the first ever Bangsamoro Parliamentary Elections.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Congratulations po sa inyong lahat.

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: Anyway, we'll give you time to submit according to the order of priorities,

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: kung ano yung gusto nyong ipaugment.

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: And let's find out if we can create some fiscal space pagdating nung GAB sa amin.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Yes, po, Mr. Chair. Maraming maraming salamat.

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: Ano pa naman? November pa naman siguro yung plenary dito eh, so...

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: Okay. So, yeah.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: I move to approve the budget of the Commission on Elections.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: And I recommend pala to approve the budget and submit it to the plenary for consideration, po.

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: There's a motion to recommend to the plenary the budget of the Comelec.

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: So, hearing no objection, so submitted, approved. Thank you.

segments.speaker: COMELEC Chairperson George Erwin M. Garcia
segments.text: Maraming salamat po, Mr. Chair. Senator Bong, maraming maraming salamat po.

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: [unclear] suspended.
